20700.name: On The Bridge

north.description: To the north lies Before The Bridge To Moria Deep.

south.description: To the south lies On The Bridge.

20700.description:
A broad humped bridge of grey stone carries the road across a chasm
whose floor is lost in mist. Low parapets, worn smooth by generations of
hands, are all that stand between you and the long fall. A cold wind
climbs out of the gorge with the muffled sound of a river far below. The
span runs on north toward its near end and south out over the gorge.

20701.name: On The Bridge

north.description: To the north lies On The Bridge.

south.description: To the south lies Before Moria Deep.

20701.description:
At the middle of the span the parapet has fallen away in one place,
leaving a ragged gap above a sheer drop of black rock. Dwarf-runes,
filled with moss, run along the surviving stones in lines no one now
reads. The roar of an unseen torrent rises from the chasm and hums in
your chest. The bridge goes on north back toward the gates and south
toward a darker shore.

extra_descs.runes dwarf-runes:
The old dwarf-runes read, in the oldest tongue, only the names of the
builders and a warning that the deep keeps what it takes.

20703.name: Before Moria Deep

north.description: To the north lies On The Bridge.

south.description: To the south lies Inside Moria Deep.

20703.description:
The bridge ends in a shelf of bare rock before a towering cliff, and in
the cliff face a tall door of iron-banded oak stands in a frame of cut
stone. Scratches and old stains mark the threshold, and gnawed bones are
ground into the gravel. A thread of torchlight leaks from the crack
beneath the door, which leads south into the deep. The span you crossed
lies behind you to the north.

20704.name: Inside Moria Deep

north.description: To the north lies Before Moria Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Guard Post.

20704.description:
Beyond the door the rock opens into a bare entry hall, its ceiling lost
in smoke and shadow. The walls are cut in great blocks, blackened by old
fires, and a rusted brazier gives off a sullen red glow. The air is foul
with damp, tallow and something older. A heavy door stands in the far
wall, leading south to the guard post, and the door you came by lies
back to the north.

20705.name: The Guard Post

north.description: To the north lies Inside Moria Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The End Of The Passage.

20705.description:
A cramped guard post has been hacked from the rock, with a table of
rough planks, a toppled stool and a rack of spears rusted into one solid
lump. Narrow slits in the wall look out on nothing but dark. Spilled
lamp oil and old blood stain the floor in dark rings. A door south leads
on into a passage, and the entry hall lies back through the door north.

20706.name: The End Of The Passage

north.description: To the north lies The Guard Post.

south.description: To the south lies The Passageway.

20706.description:
The passage ends here in a low square chamber where the hewn walls sweat
and the roof presses close overhead. A channel cut in the floor carries
a thread of black water off toward the passageway that continues south.
Long claw marks score the wall at the height of your chest. The door to
the guard post lies behind you to the north, its frame split and
hanging.

20707.name: The Passageway

north.description: To the north lies The End Of The Passage.

east.description: To the east lies Zalygin's Yard.

south.description: To the south lies The Passageway.

west.description: To the west lies Gomel's Hole.

20707.description:
A long passage cut square through the living rock runs on north and
south, its walls greasy with damp. Two doors face each other at this
junction: a warped one in the west wall opens on Gomel's Hole, and a
heavy one in the east wall opens on Zalygin's Yard. Foul smells seep
around both. A single guttering torch in an iron ring lights the
crossing.

20708.name: Gomel's Hole

east.description: To the east lies The Passageway.

20708.description:
A ragged hole gnawed from the rock, more burrow than room, its walls
scored by tooth and claw and its floor sunk into a bowl of packed earth
and rotted bedding. Narrow holes too small for a man lead off into the
stone. The reek of musk and old meat is thick enough to taste. The door
in the east wall is the only proper way out.

20709.name: Zalygin's Yard

west.description: To the west lies The Passageway.

20709.description:
What was once a drill yard for the garrison is now a wide chamber of
trampled filth and heaped refuse. Rusted weapon stands lean at crazy
angles, and the floor is cut with the ruts of dragged and heavy things.
A smell of rank hide hangs under the high ceiling. The only way out is
the door in the west wall, back to the passageway.

20710.name: Terasaki's Trashery

west.description: To the west lies The Passageway.

20710.description:
A midden of broken pots, split barrels, rags and gnawed bones fills this
den to knee depth, and the stink lays a hand across your mouth. Someone
has piled the worst of it into walls and humps, as a beast builds a
nest. Pale fungus feeds on the heap and glows faintly. The door in the
west wall is the only clean thing in sight.

20711.name: The Passageway

north.description: To the north lies The Passageway.

east.description: To the east lies Terasaki's Trashery.

south.description: To the south lies The Mouldy Stairwell.

west.description: To the west lies The Empty Room.

20711.description:
The passage bends on, its roof lower and its floor furrowed by countless
feet. In the east wall a door scrawled with crude daubs leads into
Terasaki's Trashery, and in the west wall a plain door hangs ajar on a
rotted cord, giving onto The Empty Room. South the passage dips toward a
mouldy stairwell, and the way back lies north. Pale tufts of fungus
crowd the join of wall and floor.

20712.name: The Empty Room

east.description: To the east lies The Passageway.

20712.description:
Nothing remains in this small square room but dust, a few dark marks on
the floor where furniture once stood, and a smell of long closing. The
plaster has been picked from the walls in neat lines, as though by
patient fingernails. A single iron hook hangs from the ceiling beam, and
the silence has the quality of a held breath.

20713.name: The Mouldy Stairwell

north.description: To the north lies The Passageway.

up.description: To the up lies Top of the Stairwell.

20713.description:
A narrow stair rises from the passage, each tread worn into a dish by
ages of feet and slick with black mould. The walls wear the same fur of
grey growth, and water seeps in threads over the stone. Your footsteps
sink into the damp without an echo. The steps climb up to a landing
above, while the passage lies to the north.

20714.name: Top of the Stairwell

north.description: To the north lies Along The Corridor.

down.description: To the down lies The Mouldy Stairwell.

20714.description:
The stair ends at a small landing where the mould thins and the air
grows dry and cold. A cracked niche in the wall holds a stub of tallow
burnt to a black crust. The steps fall away down the way you came, into
the damp, and a corridor leads on north. Somewhere beyond it something
heavy shifts and settles.

20715.name: Along The Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The End Of The Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies Morhun's Haunt.

south.description: To the south lies Top of the Stairwell.

west.description: To the west lies Riabev's Lair.

20715.description:
A long corridor of dressed stone runs on, its floor laid with cracked
flagstones and its walls hung with the tatters of ancient banners. The
door in the east wall is thick with cobweb and soot and leads to
Morhun's Haunt, while the pale-painted door in the west wall opens on
Riabev's Lair. A chill creeps from beneath the western door. The
corridor goes on north, and the landing of the stairwell lies south.

20716.name: Riabev's Lair

east.description: To the east lies Along The Corridor.

20716.description:
A round chamber of black stone, bare but for a slab bier in the middle
and a pale circle worn into the floor around it where something paced
for long years. A ring of candle stubs burns with a blue-white flame
that gives no warmth. Your breath hangs before you in the air. The door
in the east wall opens back onto the corridor.

20717.name: Morhun's Haunt

west.description: To the west lies Along The Corridor.

20717.description:
Dust lies like grey felt on the floor of this low chamber, undisturbed
but for one narrow track. Niches in the walls hold lumps of rotted cloth
and the grin of old bone. The air tastes of cold stone and dead lamp
oil, and a faint moaning rides it from nowhere you can find. The door in
the west wall leads back to the corridor.

20718.name: The End Of The Corridor

north.description: To the north lies Fleraw's Fate.

east.description: To the east lies Dashuk's Web.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies Asmolov's Tyrade.

20718.description:
The corridor ends in a small square hall with a door in each of its
other three walls. The north door is plain and scarred, the east door is
veiled in grey threads, and the great west door is bound in iron and
studded with the skulls of beasts. A rumbling voice leaks through it,
and the floor before it is trampled bare of dust. Torch brackets on the
walls hold only ash, and the corridor you came by lies south.

20719.name: Dashuk's Web

west.description: To the west lies The End Of The Corridor.

20719.description:
Thick grey webs fill this chamber from floor to vault, hanging in sheets
and ropes so dense that torchlight dies in them. The strands are sticky
and tough as cord, and cocoons of old bundled cloth sway in the draught.
Dry husks crunch underfoot. The door in the west wall is the only clear
path out.

20720.name: Asmolov's Tyrade

east.description: To the east lies The End Of The Corridor.

20720.description:
A vast hall with a vault lost in shadow, its floor strewn with the
wreckage of feasts: split casks, scorched bones, and a high seat built
from broken doors. Banners of cured hide hang from the pillars, each
stained with a great red handprint. A fire pit smoulders in the middle
of the floor, filling the air with smoke and the reek of burnt fat. The
door in the east wall is the only way out.

20721.name: Fleraw's Fate

south.description: To the south lies The End Of The Corridor.

20721.description:
A narrow cell of black stone, its walls bolted with iron rings, and its
floor a litter of chains and shattered shackles. Someone met an end
here: the flags are scored with a dark old stain and the rings are worn
bright. Water drips somewhere in the dark at slow, steady intervals. The
only way out is the door in the south wall.

20750.name: Before The Bridge To Moria Deep

north.description: To the north lies By The Huge Stone Gates.

south.description: To the south lies On The Bridge.

20750.description:
Here the road ends at the head of the bridge, beside a cairn of mossy
stones that marks the last honest ground before the deep. To the north
the huge stone gates of Brethrenmere stand open, their great leaves
swung wide and rusted fast against the wall. Pines lean over the track
and drip with mist. South the paving narrows and rises onto the bridge
itself.

extra_descs.cairn stones mossy:
A knee-high cairn of mossy stones, each one scratched with a small mark
by some traveller who crossed and was glad to be back, or never was.

646700.name: goblin guard moria
646700.long_desc: A Moria goblin crouches here with a notched cleaver, watching the dark with yellow eyes.
646700.description:
A hunched, grey-skinned goblin in scraps of dwarf mail, long arms
hanging to its knees. It smells of tallow and old meat.

646701.name: giant rat deep
646701.long_desc: A giant deep rat sits in the damp, gnawing at something that does not move.
646701.description:
A rat the size of a hound, bald in patches, with eyes gone milk white
from a life without sun and teeth stained brown.

646702.name: skeleton dwarf tomb
646702.long_desc: A dwarf skeleton in rotted mail stands motionless here, a rusted axe in its fingers.
646702.description:
The bones of a dwarf long dead, bound together by something other than
sinew. A cold light burns in its empty eye sockets.

646703.name: spider giant web dashuk
646703.long_desc: A giant web spider hangs in the grey threads, its legs trembling at every sound.
646703.description:
A spider the size of a cart, bristling with black hairs, with eight eyes
that glitter in the torchlight. Venom beads at the tips of its fangs.

646704.name: troll cave hulking
646704.long_desc: A hulking cave troll squats in the filth, chewing on something it should not.
646704.description:
A troll with mottled green hide and knuckles that scrape the ground. Its
small eyes are red and watery, and it grins with a mouth full of broken
teeth.

646705.name: riabev wight pale
646705.long_desc: Riabev the Pale, a gaunt wight in a tattered dwarf lord's robe, stands beside the bier.
646705.description:
Once a lord of the deep, Riabev is now a wight of grey skin and burning
eyes. A thin cold circlet rests on his brow, and the air around him
seems to still.

646706.name: asmolov ogre warlord
646706.long_desc: Asmolov, the ogre warlord of the deep, roars from his high seat and shakes the smoke from the vault.
646706.description:
Asmolov is a mountain of scarred flesh in a harness of dwarf plate
hammered flat to fit him. He carries a maul made from a stone gate-post
and curses all who enter in a voice that shakes the hall.

746700.name: cleaver goblin notched
746700.room_desc: A notched goblin cleaver lies here.
746700.description: A broad, ugly blade of poor iron, nicked from hard use but still sharp enough.

746701.name: cloak silk spider grey
746701.room_desc: A grey cloak of spidersilk lies here.
746701.description: A cloak woven of tough grey strands, light as breath and strong as cord.

746702.name: shield troll hide
746702.description: A round shield of green hide stretched over a frame of dwarf iron. Troll flesh is slow to cut, even dried.

746703.name: ring cold circlet wight
746703.room_desc: A cold silver ring lies here.
746703.description: A thin silver band that never warms to the touch, set with a pale stone.

746704.name: maul gate-post stone asmolov
746704.room_desc: A huge stone maul lies here.
746704.description: A gate-post of dwarf stone, bound in iron and fitted with a haft as thick as a man's arm. It is brutally heavy.
